description: Delete an object from the shared Object Repository. TWO-STEP CONFIRM, REQUIRED even for a single object: call once with just `id` to preview it (name/type + how many test cases, functions, or workflows still reference it); then call again with `{ id, confirm: true }` to actually delete. NEVER call this with confirm:true on the first call, and NEVER call it at all unless the user's own words asked to DELETE — a request to list, show, or read objects (object_list / object_get / "show me the objects in this test case") is NEVER a reason to call this tool. DEPENDENCY-CHECKED: if the object is still referenced by any test case, function, or workflow, the delete is REFUSED at confirm time too — it reports what still uses it instead of silently breaking those. Requires a live connection (qa_connect).

confirm.description: Set to true on the SECOND call to actually delete. Omit (or false) to preview first.

name: object_delete
title: Delete an object from the Object Repository (two-step confirm)
